summary: Friday's stronger-than-expected jobs report triggered a broad tech selloff, pushing the Nasdaq down over 4% as fresh inflation fears sent 20Y and 30Y Treasury yields back above 5%, lifting bonds while pressuring equities. Crypto deepened its collapse, with Bitcoin extending its freefall toward $60K amid a record 11-day streak of spot ETF outflows and capital rotating aggressively into AI infrastructure plays.
tweet: Hot jobs data spiked yields and crushed tech; Bitcoin's record ETF outflow streak and AI rotation are compounding a brutal week for risk.
